Package dev.opencollab.paletter.behaviour

Class ItemValues

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.behaviour.ItemValues
public final class ItemValues extends Object
The behaviour values of one item type in one palette: palette.resolve(BedrockItems.APPLE).behaviour(). Values are per item type, not per aux value. A handle is the palette's values and the position of the item in them: get reads an array and neither allocates nor boxes. Handles are equal for the same item in the same palette.

get returns the value: what the user's component sets (on a custom item or an override of a vanilla one), else the vanilla value, else BDS's default for custom content. It throws IllegalStateException where no value is known: e.g. ItemBehaviour.USE_DURATION of an item whose use is native code (bow, trident, potion), or a key of a custom item whose BDS default is not captured. getOrElse returns its fallback there instead. Both throw IllegalArgumentException for a BlockBehaviour key.

Since:
1.0.0

    • explain

      public @NonNull String explain(@NonNull BehaviourKey<?> key)
      For debugging: the value and where it comes from, e.g. 16 from Paletter data/bds/1.26.63.1/dump.json.gz (SCRIPT_API), 26.60. Says whether the user set the value, whether it is inherited from an older version's capture, and the other values of a disputed one. Builds the text on each call.
      Parameters:
      key - the key to explain, of items
      Returns:
      the explanation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the key is not an item key
